written_rules: If 1-5 scatters land, then the difference needed to trigger the feature with 6 scatters will be added to the reels.
During the base game if 5 or 6 scatters except SUPER SAW HARD HAT land, a SUPER SAW HARD HAT may be thrown onto the reels.

Mystery Stacked Reels.description: Once the reel spin initiates, each reel may contain a number of positions that are randomly replaced with PIGGY1, PIGGY2, PIGGY3, TOOLBOX or TAPE

GIRDER TRIGGER.additional_trigger_conditions: If 5 or 6 scatters except SUPER SAW HARD HAT land
